prompt: Design a Gridfinity-style 1x1 storage bin in OpenSCAD. Gridfinity uses a 42 mm grid, so the bin footprint is a 41.5 mm square with 4 mm radius rounded corners, centred on the origin. It is 40 mm tall, open at the top, with 1.2 mm walls and a 2 mm floor. Skip the baseplate feet and the stacking lip; the plain rounded-corner tub is enough. Use $fn = 48 for the corner rounding and store the grid pitch in a variable named grid_pitch.
